source_policy_decisions.decision: Exclude 7.101 as S1’s address in these editions. Its finite verb, object reference and addressees are evidenced separately. The named scene in 3.19–23 is also insufficient.
Credit the witnessed sam-gam aorist with kit. The prospective sense does not license substituting a loṭ spelling in the text.
Admit the joy causative from the object and gloss. Exclude the contact homograph. A commentary paraphrase in another pada adds no finite position.

The verse supplies direct literary support on the PG86 marriage branch. Keep the distinct signalling sense and the uncertainty about āṅ attachment in the apparatus. No new finite row for either yam token here.
Retain the finite quote, the pronominal expansion and both supplied elliptic frames at their prior owners. No additional noun case position.
